final: WITH per_frequency AS (SELECT a.frequency, AVG(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN -t.amount END) AS avg_signed_amount, AVG(t.balance) AS avg_balance FROM trans AS t JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = t.account_id GROUP BY a.frequency), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_signed_amount) AS mean_signed_amount FROM per_frequency) SELECT AVG(p.avg_signed_amount) AS avg_signed_amount, AVG(p.avg_balance) AS avg_balance, AVG(p.avg_signed_amount - o.mean_signed_amount) AS avg_excess FROM per_frequency AS p CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE p.avg_signed_amount > o.mean_signed_amount
